content.text:
I read "GH292" as GitHub issue #292 and removed the `components/**` override from `pyrefly.toml`. Pyrefly then reports no `bad-index` findings, so I didn't need to change any component code.

The issue expected 34 `bad-index` findings in `components/ui/`. I checked with pyrefly 1.3.1, the version pinned in `.trunk/trunk.yaml`, and with 1.4.1. Both report 0 errors (9 suppressed). A run that reports suppressed errors also finds no `bad-index`. Other changes since the issue was written probably cleared them, but I didn't check which ones.

I committed the removal as `8ad9269` on `w-753/bootstrap`. I haven't pushed it or opened a PR.

I only ran the pyrefly check. I didn't run the repo's tests or Trunk.
